board_name: West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education
headquarters: Vidyasagar Bhavan, 9/2, Block DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake, Kolkata - 700091

class_11.examination_status: Semester-Based Higher Secondary Foundation (Semester I & II)

progression_to_class_12.rule: Promotion to Class 12 requires qualifying Class 11 Semester assessments under WBCHSE regulations.

subject_sets.set_I: Science Group (Physics, Chemistry, Math, Bio Science, CS, Stat, etc.)
subject_sets.set_II: Commerce Group (Accountancy, Business Studies, CLPA, Costing & Tax, Econ, etc.)
subject_sets.set_III: Humanities Group (History, Geography, Pol Sci, Philosophy, Sociology, etc.)

class_12.passing_criteria: Minimum 30% in Theory and 30% in Practical/Project separately, with minimum 30% aggregate.
